name: getCurrentSkyCultureEnglishName
description: Returns the English name of the currently active sky culture. Sky cultures define how constellations, star names, and celestial artwork are presented based on different cultural traditions (e.g., 'Western', 'Chinese', 'Egyptian').
returnDescription: English name of the current sky culture

compatibility.notes: Backed by Q_PROPERTY 'currentSkyCultureID' (indirectly). Read-only getter.

example:
var cultureName = StelSkyCultureMgr.getCurrentSkyCultureEnglishName();
core.debug('Current sky culture: ' + cultureName);

name: getCurrentSkyCultureNameI18
description: Returns the translated name of the currently active sky culture in the current UI language. This is the localized display name shown in the GUI.
returnDescription: Translated name of the current sky culture

compatibility.notes: Uses SkyCultureDescriptionsTranslator for translation.

example:
var localizedName = StelSkyCultureMgr.getCurrentSkyCultureNameI18();
core.debug('Localized culture name: ' + localizedName);

name: setCurrentSkyCultureNameI18
description: Sets the current sky culture using its translated name (as displayed in the GUI). If the name matches a valid sky culture, it will be loaded and applied. Internally converts the i18n name to a directory ID via skyCultureI18ToDirectory() and calls setCurrentSkyCultureID().

parameters.name: cultureName
parameters.description: Translated name of the sky culture to activate (e.g., 'Modern', 'Chinese', 'Egyptian')

returnDescription: true if the sky culture was successfully changed, false otherwise

compatibility.notes: Calls setCurrentSkyCultureID() internally. Emits currentSkyCultureChanged and currentSkyCultureIDChanged.

name: getCurrentSkyCultureID
description: Returns the unique identifier (directory name) of the currently active sky culture. This ID corresponds to the folder name in the skycultures directory.
returnDescription: Sky culture ID (e.g., 'modern', 'chinese', 'egyptian')

compatibility.notes: Backed by Q_PROPERTY 'currentSkyCultureID'. Also accessible via core.getStelProperty('StelSkyCultureMgr.currentSkyCultureID').

name: setCurrentSkyCultureID
description: Sets the current sky culture using its unique identifier (directory name). This is the programmatic way to change sky cultures, using IDs like 'modern', 'chinese', or 'egyptian'. If the ID is invalid, the function falls back to 'modern' and returns false. Emits currentSkyCultureChanged and currentSkyCultureIDChanged.
returnDescription: true if the sky culture was successfully changed, false if the ID was invalid (falls back to 'modern')

compatibility.notes: Backed by Q_PROPERTY 'currentSkyCultureID'. On invalid ID: qWarning() + fallback to 'modern' + returns false. NOTE: 'western' is NOT auto-converted here — that conversion happens only in init() for the default sky culture.

name: reloadSkyCulture
description: Reloads the currently active sky culture from disk. Useful after making manual changes to sky culture definition files (index.json, description.md, constellation data, or artwork). Internally re-scans the skycultures directory and re-applies the current ID.

compatibility.notes: Preserves the current sky culture ID across the reload.

name: getCurrentSkyCultureBoundariesType
description: Returns the type of constellation boundaries used in the current sky culture. The value corresponds to the StelSkyCulture::BoundariesType enum: -1=None (no boundaries), 0=IAU (official IAU boundaries), 1=Own (custom boundaries defined by the sky culture).
returnDescription: Boundary type enum: -1=None, 0=IAU, 1=Own

compatibility.notes: Enum defined in StelSkyCulture (Q_GADGET). Read from 'edges_type' in index.json; defaults to None if not specified.

name: getCurrentSkyCultureClassificationIdx
description: Returns the classification index of the current sky culture. Classifications indicate the nature and origin of the sky culture: 0=Incomplete, 1=Personal, 2=Traditional, 3=Ethnographic, 4=Historical, 5=Single source, 6=Comparative. The value corresponds to the StelSkyCulture::CLASSIFICATION enum.
returnDescription: Classification enum (0-6): 0=Incomplete, 1=Personal, 2=Traditional, 3=Ethnographic, 4=Historical, 5=Single, 6=Comparative

compatibility.notes: Enum defined in StelSkyCulture (Q_GADGET). Read from 'classification' array in index.json; first item is used. Defaults to INCOMPLETE if not specified.

name: getCurrentSkyCultureHtmlClassification
description: Returns an HTML-formatted description of the current sky culture's classification, including the classification name, a localized description, and a color-coded indicator dot. Colors: green for ethnographic/historical/single/traditional, blue for comparative, yellow for personal, red for incomplete.
returnDescription: HTML string describing the sky culture classification

compatibility.notes: Returns empty string if classification is undefined. Uses <dl>/<dt>/<dd> HTML structure.

name: getCurrentSkyCultureHtmlLicense
description: Returns an HTML-formatted description of the license information for the current sky culture. Handles GPL, MIT, Public Domain, Creative Commons (CC-BY, CC-BY-SA, CC-BY-ND, CC-BY-NC, CC-BY-NC-SA, CC-BY-NC-ND, CC0), and Free Art License. Color-codes: green for free licenses, yellow for ND (weak restriction), red for NC (strong restriction).
returnDescription: HTML string describing the license terms

compatibility.notes: Supports single-line and multi-line license sections. Returns empty string if license section is empty.

name: getCurrentSkyCultureHtmlRegion
description: Returns an HTML-formatted description of the geographical region of origin for the current sky culture. For sky cultures whose ID contains 'modern' (e.g., 'modern', 'modern_iau'), returns 'World' as the region with a special description about IAU constellations.
returnDescription: HTML string describing the region of origin

compatibility.notes: Region is read from the 'region' array in index.json. For 'modern*' cultures, overridden to 'World'.

name: getCurrentSkyCultureHtmlDescription
description: Returns a complete HTML-formatted description of the current sky culture. This includes the culture name, introduction, description sections, constellation details (converted from Markdown), license information, classification, and region information. Reads description.md from the sky culture directory and converts Markdown to HTML.
returnDescription: Complete HTML description of the sky culture

compatibility.notes: Returns a fallback 'No description' HTML if description.md is missing. Appends license, classification, and region HTML blocks.

name: getCurrentSkyCultureNarration
description: Returns a plain text narration of the current sky culture suitable for text-to-speech. This includes the culture name and introduction text, but EXCLUDES sections starting from '## Constellations' (constellation texts are narrated individually when selected) and excludes references/authors/license sections.
returnDescription: Plain text narration of the sky culture

compatibility.notes: Truncates markdown at '## Constellations'. Uses SkyCultureDescriptionsTranslator for translation.

name: getDefaultSkyCultureID
description: Returns the default sky culture ID as configured in Stellarium's settings (localization/sky_culture). This is the sky culture that will be loaded when the application starts.
returnDescription: Default sky culture ID (e.g., 'modern')

compatibility.notes: Backed by Q_PROPERTY 'defaultSkyCultureID'. Read from settings key 'localization/sky_culture' (default: 'modern'). NOTE: 'western' is auto-converted to 'modern' during init() only.

name: setDefaultSkyCultureID
description: Sets the default sky culture ID that will be used when Stellarium starts. This setting is saved to the configuration file (localization/sky_culture) immediately by the C++ implementation — no additional save call is needed. If the ID is invalid, the function returns false and does not change the setting.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Sky culture identifier to set as default (e.g., 'modern', 'chinese', 'egyptian')

returnDescription: true if the default was successfully set, false if the ID is invalid

compatibility.notes: Backed by Q_PROPERTY 'defaultSkyCultureID'. Saves to QSettings('localization/sky_culture') internally. Does NOT change the CURRENT sky culture — use setCurrentSkyCultureID() for that. Emits defaultSkyCultureIDChanged.

name: getSkyCultureListEnglish
description: Returns a list of all available sky culture names in English. The list order follows the internal QMap ordering (alphabetical by directory ID, not by English name).
returnDescription: List of English sky culture names

compatibility.notes: Iterates dirToNameEnglish QMap in key order (directory ID). For alphabetically sorted I18N names, use getSkyCultureListI18().

name: getSkyCultureListI18
description: Returns a list of all available sky culture names translated to the current UI language, SORTED alphabetically using locale-aware comparison (unlike getSkyCultureListEnglish which follows directory order).
returnDescription: Sorted list of translated sky culture names

compatibility.notes: Sorted via QString::localeAwareCompare. Intended for GUI use.

name: getSkyCultureRegionMapI18
description: Returns a multimap from translated sky culture names to their geographical regions (UN M49 geoscheme). A sky culture may belong to multiple regions, hence QMultiMap. The legacy region key 'Southern America' is automatically corrected to 'South America' with a warning.
returnDescription: Multimap of translated culture name → region name

compatibility.notes: QMultiMap may be limited in QJSEngine; access via iteration is recommended. Legacy 'Southern America' → 'South America'.

name: getSkyCultureTimeLimitMapI18
description: Returns a map from translated sky culture names to their time limits (beginYear, endYear). The time span is derived from territory.geojson polygons. Special sentinel values: beginTime = -100000 means 'unknown/irrelevant', endTime = 9146 means 'present/∞'.
returnDescription: Map of translated culture name → (beginYear, endYear)

compatibility.notes: Sentinels: unknownBeginTime = -100000, presentEndTime = 9146. QMap/QPair conversion may be limited in QJSEngine.

name: getSkyCultureListIDs
description: Returns a list of all available sky culture IDs (directory names). These are the values accepted by setCurrentSkyCultureID().
returnDescription: List of sky culture directory IDs

compatibility.notes: Returns QMap keys in internal order.

name: getDirToNameMap
description: Returns the internal map from sky culture directory IDs to full StelSkyCulture objects (containing id, path, englishName, license, region, time span, constellations, boundaries, asterisms, classification, names, etc.). WARNING: StelSkyCulture is a Q_GADGET, not Q_DECLARE_METATYPE — conversion to a usable JS object may be limited or unavailable on Qt6/QJSEngine.
returnDescription: Map of directory ID → StelSkyCulture gadget (limited JS usability)

compatibility.notes: StelSkyCulture is Q_GADGET (not Q_DECLARE_METATYPE). QJSEngine (Qt6) may not expose its fields. NOT recommended for scripting — use getSkyCultureListIDs() + getCurrentSkyCulture*() accessors instead.

name: getDirToI18Map
description: Returns a map from sky culture directory IDs to their translated names in the current UI language. Unlike getDirToNameMap, this returns plain QString values and is safe to use in scripts.
returnDescription: Map of directory ID → translated name

compatibility.notes: QMap<QString,QString> converts to a JS object on QJSEngine. Safe for scripting.

name: convertCulturalDisplayStyleFromCSVstring
description: STATIC method. Converts a comma-separated string of display-style tokens into the combined StelObject::CulturalDisplayStyle bitflag enum. Valid tokens (case-insensitive): 'none', 'modern', 'byname', 'ipa', 'translated', 'translit', 'pronounce', 'native'. Multiple tokens can be combined with commas (e.g., 'Native,IPA,Translated'). Unknown tokens are ignored (mapped to NONE).
returnDescription: Combined bitflag enum value

compatibility.notes: STATIC method — callable as StelSkyCultureMgr.convertCulturalDisplayStyleFromCSVstring(...). Uses bitwise OR to combine tokens. Unknown tokens map to NONE.

name: convertCulturalDisplayStyleToCSVstring
description: STATIC method. Converts a StelObject::CulturalDisplayStyle bitflag enum back into a comma-separated string of tokens. Inverse of convertCulturalDisplayStyleFromCSVstring().
returnDescription: Comma-separated style tokens

compatibility.notes: STATIC method. Internally uses QVariant::fromValue(style).toString().replace('_', ',').

name: getScreenLabelStyle
description: Returns the screen-label display style for the current sky culture as a bitflag enum. This controls how star/constellation names are formatted on screen (e.g., native, translated, IPA, pronunciation). Stored per-sky-culture under SCScreenLabelStyle/<id> in settings. Defaults to Translated if defaultSkyCultureID is empty (testing mode).
returnDescription: Combined display-style enum

compatibility.notes: Backed by Q_PROPERTY 'screenLabelStyle'. Per-sky-culture settings key: SCScreenLabelStyle/<currentID>. Default: Translated.

name: getScreenLabelStyleString
description: Scripting-friendly version of getScreenLabelStyle(). Returns the screen-label display style as a comma-separated string of tokens instead of an enum bitflag.
returnDescription: Comma-separated style tokens (e.g., 'Native,Translated')

compatibility.notes: Calls convertCulturalDisplayStyleToCSVstring(getScreenLabelStyle()). RECOMMENDED for scripts over the enum getter.

name: setScreenLabelStyle
description: Sets the screen-label display style for the current sky culture. Accepts either a comma-separated string of tokens ('native,ipa,translated') or an enum-like underscore string ('Native_IPA_Translated'). Saved per-sky-culture under SCScreenLabelStyle/<id> in settings. Emits screenLabelStyleChanged.

parameters.name: style
parameters.description: Comma-separated tokens or underscore-style string (e.g., 'Native,IPA' or 'Native_IPA')

compatibility.notes: Backed by Q_PROPERTY 'screenLabelStyle'. Two C++ overloads exist (enum + QString); scripts use the QString overload. Saved to QSettings('SCScreenLabelStyle/<currentID>'). NOTE: saved per sky culture — switching culture restores that culture's style.

name: getInfoLabelStyle
description: Returns the info-panel label display style for the current sky culture as a bitflag enum. Controls how names are formatted in the object information panel. Stored per-sky-culture under SCInfoLabelStyle/<id>. Defaults to Translated if defaultSkyCultureID is empty.
returnDescription: Combined display-style enum

compatibility.notes: Backed by Q_PROPERTY 'infoLabelStyle'. Per-sky-culture key: SCInfoLabelStyle/<currentID>. Default: Translated.

name: getInfoLabelStyleString
description: Scripting-friendly version of getInfoLabelStyle(). Returns the info-panel display style as a comma-separated string of tokens.
returnDescription: Comma-separated style tokens

compatibility.notes: RECOMMENDED for scripts over the enum getter.

example:
var styleStr = StelSkyCultureMgr.getInfoLabelStyleString();
core.debug('Info style: ' + styleStr);

name: setInfoLabelStyle
description: Sets the info-panel label display style for the current sky culture. Accepts comma-separated tokens or underscore-style string. Saved per-sky-culture under SCInfoLabelStyle/<id>. Emits infoLabelStyleChanged.

compatibility.notes: Backed by Q_PROPERTY 'infoLabelStyle'. Saved per sky culture.

name: getZodiacLabelStyle
description: Returns the zodiac-label display style for the current sky culture as a bitflag enum. Controls how zodiac sign names are formatted. Stored per-sky-culture under SCZodiacLabelStyle/<id>. Defaults to Translated if defaultSkyCultureID is empty.
returnDescription: Combined display-style enum

compatibility.notes: Backed by Q_PROPERTY 'zodiacLabelStyle'. Per-sky-culture key: SCZodiacLabelStyle/<currentID>.

example:
var styleStr = StelSkyCultureMgr.getZodiacLabelStyleString();
core.debug('Zodiac label style: ' + styleStr);

name: getZodiacLabelStyleString
description: Scripting-friendly version of getZodiacLabelStyle(). Returns the zodiac display style as a comma-separated string of tokens.
returnDescription: Comma-separated style tokens

compatibility.notes: RECOMMENDED for scripts over the enum getter.

example:
var styleStr = StelSkyCultureMgr.getZodiacLabelStyleString();
core.debug('Zodiac style: ' + styleStr);

name: setZodiacLabelStyle
description: Sets the zodiac-label display style for the current sky culture. Saved per-sky-culture under SCZodiacLabelStyle/<id>. Emits zodiacLabelStyleChanged.

compatibility.notes: Backed by Q_PROPERTY 'zodiacLabelStyle'. Saved per sky culture.

name: getLunarSystemLabelStyle
description: Returns the lunar-system label display style for the current sky culture as a bitflag enum. Controls how lunar mansion / nakshatra names are formatted. Stored per-sky-culture under SCLunarSystemLabelStyle/<id>. Defaults to Translated if defaultSkyCultureID is empty.
returnDescription: Combined display-style enum

compatibility.notes: Backed by Q_PROPERTY 'lunarSystemLabelStyle'. Per-sky-culture key: SCLunarSystemLabelStyle/<currentID>.

example:
var styleStr = StelSkyCultureMgr.getLunarSystemLabelStyleString();
core.debug('Lunar system label style: ' + styleStr);

name: getLunarSystemLabelStyleString
description: Scripting-friendly version of getLunarSystemLabelStyle(). Returns the lunar-system display style as a comma-separated string of tokens.
returnDescription: Comma-separated style tokens

compatibility.notes: RECOMMENDED for scripts over the enum getter.

example:
var styleStr = StelSkyCultureMgr.getLunarSystemLabelStyleString();
core.debug('Lunar style: ' + styleStr);

name: setLunarSystemLabelStyle
description: Sets the lunar-system label display style for the current sky culture. Saved per-sky-culture under SCLunarSystemLabelStyle/<id>. Emits lunarSystemLabelStyleChanged.

compatibility.notes: Backed by Q_PROPERTY 'lunarSystemLabelStyle'. Saved per sky culture.

name: getFlagOverrideUseCommonNames
description: Returns whether Stellarium ignores the sky culture author's 'fallback_to_international_names' setting and always shows common/international names in addition to cultural names.
returnDescription: true if common-name override is active, false otherwise

compatibility.notes: Backed by Q_PROPERTY 'flagOverrideUseCommonNames'. Read from settings key 'viewing/flag_skyculture_always_fallback_to_international_names' during init().

example:
var override = StelSkyCultureMgr.getFlagOverrideUseCommonNames();
core.debug('Common-name override: ' + override);

name: setFlagOverrideUseCommonNames
description: Sets whether to ignore the sky culture's own 'fallback_to_international_names' setting and always show common/international names. NOTE: this setter does NOT save to settings — the change is lost on restart (unlike setFlagUseAbbreviatedNames). Emits flagOverrideUseCommonNamesChanged.

parameters.name: override
parameters.description: true to force common names, false to respect the sky culture's setting

compatibility.notes: Backed by Q_PROPERTY 'flagOverrideUseCommonNames'. NOT saved to settings — contrast with setFlagUseAbbreviatedNames which IS saved.

name: getFlagUseAbbreviatedNames
description: Returns whether shortest-name labels (constellation abbreviations like 'Ori', 'UMa') are shown instead of full cultural labels.
returnDescription: true if abbreviated names are used, false otherwise

compatibility.notes: Backed by Q_PROPERTY 'flagUseAbbreviatedNames'. Read from settings key 'viewing/flag_constellation_abbreviations' during init().

example:
var abbreviated = StelSkyCultureMgr.getFlagUseAbbreviatedNames();
core.debug('Abbreviated names: ' + abbreviated);

name: setFlagUseAbbreviatedNames
description: Sets whether to show shortest-name labels (constellation abbreviations) instead of full cultural labels. Saved to settings (viewing/flag_constellation_abbreviations) — persists across restarts. Emits flagUseAbbreviatedNamesChanged.

parameters.name: b
parameters.description: true to use abbreviated names, false for full labels

compatibility.notes: Backed by Q_PROPERTY 'flagUseAbbreviatedNames'. Saved to QSettings('viewing/flag_constellation_abbreviations') via StelApp::immediateSave. Contrast with setFlagOverrideUseCommonNames which is NOT saved.

name: currentSkycultureUsesCommonNames
description: Returns whether the CURRENT sky culture incorporates common/international names, taking into account both the sky culture's own 'fallback_to_international_names' setting AND the global override flag. This is the effective value (not the raw setting).
returnDescription: true if the effective behavior includes common names, false otherwise

compatibility.notes: Returns currentSkyCulture.fallbackToInternationalNames, which is set during makeCulturesList() as: (flagOverrideUseCommonNames || data['fallback_to_international_names'].toBool()).

name: analyzeScreenLabel
description: DEVELOPMENT/DEBUG function. Analyzes the Unicode properties of the currently selected object's screen label and prints a detailed character-by-character breakdown (category, script, direction, decomposition) to the debug console. Requires an object to be selected; does nothing if selection is empty. Not intended for production scripts.

compatibility.notes: DEBUG/DEVELOPMENT ONLY. Output goes to qDebug() console, not to core.output. Requires a selected object (via StelObjectMgr). For stars, attempts to resolve HIP number and use StarMgr.getCulturalScreenLabel().
